purpose: Qualify a complete 2012-2021 historical supervised-label source for P(active) without fitting V09B or using completed 2026 outcomes.

training_universe.universe_authority: canonical nflverse regular-season schedule joined by season/week/home/away/game identifier

label_semantics.negative_class: player is listed on the official game-specific inactive list
label_semantics.positive_class: player belongs to the auditable game-day eligible roster universe and is not listed on the official game-specific inactive list
label_semantics.inactive_observation_time: official game-day inactive declaration, approximately 90 minutes before kickoff

legacy_2012_2016.discovery_crosswalk: archived BurntSushi/nflgame schedule.json containing event id plus legacy gamekey
legacy_2012_2016.crosswalk_role: locator discovery only; label authority remains official NFL Gamebook bytes
legacy_2012_2016.known_coverage_boundary: archived schedule contains the 2016 regular season through Week 17; no 2017-season records have been established from that source

modern_2017_2021.first_party_evidence: historical NFL Game Center pages expose Download Game Book PDF
modern_2017_2021.remaining_locator_requirement: resolve and archive the direct official Game Book document URL or equivalent immutable first-party bytes for every canonical game

prohibited_shortcuts: drop games with missing Game Books
treat weekly roster INA as game-specific inactive truth
treat Did Not Play as inactive
treat absence from inactive list as active without a game-day roster universe
infer active from snaps or play-by-play appearance
relax coverage thresholds after seeing source availability
